returns.note: MIT Dataverse direct download returned HTTP 400. The committed normalized mirror was used instead. Missing 2024 rows fall back to 2020. Baseline weights: 80% 2024, 15% 2020, 5% 2016; missing years use the latest available row.

geometry.note: Legacy county geometry. Alaska statewide aggregate has no fabricated borough values. Connecticut keeps eight legacy counties; current ACS planning regions are not joined to them.

acs.note: 2023 five-year county estimates. Education=bachelor-or-higher adult share; white=non-Hispanic white share; young=ages 18–34 / total population; income=median household income. These are population attributes, not observed voter demographics. Urbanicity remains neutral; religion omitted. Unmatched geographies use neutral defaults.

districts.license: Attributed public election facts; no blanket license asserted for state source documents
districts.note: 2024 district two-party priors. Maine totals include named candidates in the certificate, not any omitted write-ins. Simulated district swings follow state swings, not a county-to-precinct crosswalk.

electors.note: 2020 apportionment applicable to 2024 and 2028; 538 total, DC 3.

polling.note: Neutral 50% approval, zero generic ballot and zero economic sentiment are scenario assumptions, not measured facts. Update polling.json manually with a permissible source and date before replacing these defaults.
